name: CAMERON RYDWELL
awards: FBLA 2022 - STATE and REGIONAL 1st Place: Mobile Application Development
FBLA 2023 - STATE and REGIONAL 1st Place: Computer Game and Programming Simulation
bio: I'm a creative visionary with one goal in mind spread across countless outlets: represent my true self and make art doing it. I'm a firm believer in the quote 'If you set your goals ridiciously high, and its a failure, you will fail above everyone elses success', and hold this belief every single day. From coding games/websites/apps, to building my car, I have always felt the desire to create what reflects my personality. When I'm not behind a screen, you can find me either behind the movie screen or the camera myself, documenting my life to look back on.
title: Engineer, Content Creator, Visionary
